furnace.prompt: Inside a silicon furnace hall: a big round furnace of glowing melt in the middle distance, a chute pouring pale quartz gravel and black carbon lumps in from the left, broad simple walls, an empty floor in front for a character to stand on.
furnace.variant: the glow in the furnace and the sparks flicker and shift

inside.variant: the flames curl the other way and leap a little higher

pour.variant: the steam has drifted up and the pouring stream ripples

tumble_4.pose: landing upright with a little bounce, still holding hands with the two red oxygen twins, all three dizzy and laughing; the two oxygen twins look exactly like the two small red balls in the model sheet, perfectly round and smooth
